Sales & Marketing Intern - SaaS

LuGo-Test is looking for a motivated Sales & Marketing Intern to join our growing SaaS company.

Apply now

What you'll do

  • Manage and grow our presence on G2, including review campaigns and profile optimization.
  • Research and reach out to potential customers via LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, and email.
  • Support lead generation and follow-ups.
  • Assist with social media and marketing activities.
  • Learn our platform and gradually participate in product demos.

What we're looking for

  • Student or recent graduate in Marketing, Business, Entrepreneurship, or a related field.
  • Excellent English and communication skills.
  • Interest in SaaS, technology, sales, and digital marketing.
  • Proactive, independent, and eager to learn.
  • Experience with G2, LinkedIn, or B2B marketing is a strong advantage.
“

This is a hands-on internship with real responsibility and the potential to grow into a Junior SDR / Marketing role.
